subject: Purchase order windows for bookings recognition and invoicing timing
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@argentco.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-05T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Purchase order windows for bookings recognition and invoicing timing

Hi Maya —

Following up on our procurement thread: we want to confirm the exact PO/invoice timing that will allow revenue to be recognized in December for the ARG-2026-9843 deal. For forecasting and month-end close we need clarity on two things:

1) What is ArgentCo's internal cutoff for a PO + matched invoice to be processed in the same month?
2) If the PO is issued but the invoice is received after that cutoff, when will Redwood expect the invoice to be paid/processed (and therefore when should we plan bookings recognition)?

To make this concrete, here are the three scenarios we typically see and how they impact our recognition:
- Invoice + signed PO received by Dec 10 -> include in December bookings (closeable this month).
- Invoice received between Dec 11–Dec 20 -> may be processed for December if AP confirms; needs expedited matching and sign-off.
- Invoice after Dec 21 -> will fall into January for revenue recognition.

Can you confirm where ArgentCo's AP cutoffs fall and whether there's any ability to expedite for this contract? I attached a one-pager with proposed commit windows for your reference.

We need a reply by EOD Tuesday (Dec 7) so revenue ops can finalize the December forecast. Thanks — appreciate any flexibility from AP to help with month-end.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Thanks Jonas —

On Fri, Dec 5, 2026 at 09:14 Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Maya —
> 
> Following up on our procurement thread: we want to confirm the exact PO/invoice timing that will allow revenue to be recognized in December for the ARG-2026-9843 deal.

We're happy to help. Our standard AP schedule is: PO signed + invoice received by Dec 10 -> processed in December. If the invoice arrives between Dec 11–Dec 17, AP can triage for December clearance but it requires the PO number and an expedited coding form. Invoices after Dec 17 are scheduled for the next month's run (Jan).

I copied our AP mailbox to flag this request. Please share the final PO number and a PDF invoice (or a DocuSign confirmation) so we can route it quickly. If Redwood can confirm that the service acceptance happened by Dec 9 (short acceptance note from the PM), we can lock this into the Dec run.

Best,
Maya Singh
Finance Operations | ArgentCo

On Fri, Dec 5, 2026 at 11:03 Maya Singh <maya.singh@argentco.com> wrote:
> We're happy to help. Our standard AP schedule is: PO signed + invoice received by Dec 10 -> processed in December.

To make sure finance can include ARG in the December bookings: we need the invoice to be matched to a signed PO and a one-line acceptance or delivery confirmation by the customer by Dec 10 PDT. If AP agrees to triage between Dec 11–Dec 17, we need written confirmation from AP that they will process an exception for this deal and an internal PO reference (so we have an audit trail).

Actions:
- Tessa (sales) to secure the signed PO and ask the customer for a short acceptance note (email/purchase confirmation) no later than Dec 9.
- Jonas/RevOps to send the final PO PDF and deal HubSpot link to accounts.payments@argentco.com once PO is signed.
- Finance (me) will prepare a commit note for the forecasting deck if we get AP's written triage confirmation.

I've attached a quick Cutoff_Checklist that lists docs we need for a Dec inclusion.

Laura Bennett
